entries.author: mlynxqualey
entries.summary: The title here is borrowed from the French edition, Un goût de thé amer, which was translated by Sarah Rolfo, while the Arabic original is titled العراك في جهنم. entries.title: Lele Hotel / The Lab Evn
entries.author: Nina Vuga
entries.summary: Located in Vayots Dzor, Lele Hotel is conceived as a direct response to the character and topography of its mountainous surroundings.
